ring.intro: Ropes mark a square of trampled grass where two roads cross. A crowd stands three deep around it, and coins change hands before anyone has moved.
ring.offer: A broad woman with a scarred forearm leans on the ropes. "Marda Ironhand. Fifty gold says you cannot beat me. Win, and you take a hundred. Three bouts, no more: I have a living to make."
ring.wins: The crowd knows you now: you have won {count} bouts in this ring.
ring.won: The crowd roars. {foe} spits, laughs, and pays you 100 gold. "Fairly done."
ring.lost: {foe} pockets your wager and helps you up. "Come back when you have learned something."
ring.spent: The ropes are coiled and the crowd has drifted off. Marda is counting her takings and does not look up.
ring.master: Accept the Ringmaster's own bout ({price} gold against {foe})
ring.master_won: {foe} bows, deeply, for the first time in years. He pays 400 gold from his own purse, and the crowd carries you twice around the ring.
ring.master_lost: {foe} folds his coat back over his arm. "You fought well. Not well enough." Your 150 gold stays with him.
